recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-14368; future ImmunizationEvaluation narrative maintenance belongs with the Immunization Incubator IG rather than this core checkout.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction for FHIR-core ImmunizationEvaluation asking to fix typos in section 11.14.5: prepared/generated wording, the influenza and diphtheria/tetanus vaccinations example, and the misspelled ImmunizationRecommedation resource name.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-14368-tagged source commit was found. The typo family was applied implicitly: f451f3fc4b093f23541fadb82141a50def0e1cc5 corrected generated/flu/diphtheria-tetanus wording, 9ace2dad1eb9b4f1bccce0a2035a63f4971be1e3 corrected prepare to prepared, and 0e346f989a46d72bacfb48835108d71abb37ed39 corrected ImmunizationRecommedation to ImmunizationRecommendation in ImmunizationEvaluation narrative source.
additional_context: FHIR-14369 is an identical same-change-family typo request and is already represented on the combined branch by commit 6da2525a0acc20ad5c429dba174af56784b93837. Later commit e073fb45ec6f5a738a9f674baf63406bfe90fb78 removed ImmunizationEvaluation and ImmunizationRecommendation from active FHIR core build entries and deleted their local source folders. Current core narrative links ImmunizationEvaluation to the HL7 Immunization Incubator IG, whose current rendered page contains the corrected paragraph. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting record for FHIR-14368.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No FHIR core source edit is appropriate because there is no active local ImmunizationEvaluation page to edit, historical core source corrected the reported typos before resource removal, and the current linked external artifact is already corrected.
